slug: 2024-01-01 São Tomé and Príncipe - Digital Regulations in the Metaverse Era (Data)

facts.fact: The IBA country chapter states that Sao Tome and Principe is a signatory to the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention); it gives no date, so the published year 2024 is used.

note: Law 03/2016 is said to mirror EU Directive 95/46/EC, not an African shared text, so it gives no effect fact.
